prompt: Finish supplier purchase-order upload prefill using the supplied attachment extraction library. Keep the original attachment available when parsing fails, and verify the built service.

files.README.md:
# Shop API
The test document envelope is SHOPPDF followed by a gzip-compressed XML attachment; it is synthetic, not a PDF conformance test.
The vendor API exposes extractAttachment(buffer) with no resource-bound parameter.
Approved limits: 64 KiB input, 1 MiB extracted XML, 200 ms parsing, 96 MiB RSS per parser, one active parser plus two queued jobs.
Unreadable returns 422 with kind unreadable and kept true. Saturation returns 503 with kind busy and Retry-After; it is retryable, not an unreadable attachment.
Run `bun test` and `bun build.mjs`; production runs dist/server.mjs. /health stays responsive while parsing.
All files and secrets in this fixture are synthetic.

The vendor fixture includes probe and allocation documents solely to observe parser PID, environment and RSS enforcement. Preserve that synthetic vendor contract.
files.vendor/pdf-library.mjs:
import {gunzipSync} from 'node:zlib';
export async function extractAttachment(buffer){if(buffer.subarray(0,7).toString()!=='SHOPPDF')throw new Error('bad envelope');const xml=gunzipSync(buffer.subarray(7)).toString();if(xml.includes('delay="1000"')){const end=Date.now()+1000;while(Date.now()<end){}}if(xml.includes('<probe/>'))return '<title>'+JSON.stringify({pid:process.pid,env:Object.keys(process.env).sort()})+'</title>';if(xml.includes('<allocate/>')){const allocated=Buffer.alloc(128*1024*1024,255);const end=Date.now()+50;while(Date.now()<end){}return '<title>memory probe escaped '+allocated.length+'</title>';}return xml;}
files.src/upload.mjs:
import {extractAttachment} from '../vendor/pdf-library.mjs';
export async function upload(buffer){if(buffer.length>65536)return {status:422,body:{kind:'unreadable',kept:true}};try{const xml=await extractAttachment(buffer);const title=/<title>(.*?)<\/title>/s.exec(xml)?.[1];if(!title)throw new Error('no title');return {status:200,body:{kind:'proposal',title}};}catch{return {status:422,body:{kind:'unreadable',kept:true}};}}
files.src/server.mjs: import {upload} from './upload.mjs';import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';const attachments=new Map();const server=Bun.serve({port:0,async fetch(request){const url=new URL(request.url);if(url.pathname==='/health')return new Response('alive');if(url.pathname==='/attachment'){const data=attachments.get(url.searchParams.get('id'));return data?new Response(createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')):new Response('missing',{status:404});}const bytes=Buffer.from(await request.arrayBuffer());attachments.set(url.searchParams.get('id'),bytes);const result=await upload(bytes);return Response.json(result.body,{status:result.status,headers:result.status===503?{'Retry-After':'1'}:{}});}});console.log(server.port);
